result_revision: uncommitted; user owns staging, commits and pushes
scope: Current Windows PC window cube, owned resource lifetime and relocated precompiled Runtime distribution; existing WSL CPU/headless regression. No scene authoring, live MMO, other hardware or production release qualification.

identity_audit.post_cpu_change: Only the isolated PowerShell helper received explicit UTF-8 text decoding after full CPU runs; it is not a C++ build/native-fixture input. Focused final package tests and real Unicode negatives below cover the final helper.

environments.local_limits: Windows client/editor GPUs only; WSL native window/graphics OFF. Existing development tools remain installed; no Mac, native Linux graphics, additional machine, hosted gate, driver or host-resource changes.

wsl_verification.scope: WSL CPU-only EngineClient Debug and ASan/UBSan regression after versioned shader bundle, shared cube presentation and capture implementation; no native Linux GPU or new Server package qualification.

native_acceptance.required_validation: Vulkan core and synchronization plus NVRHI; no unexpected warnings/errors/dropped diagnostics. Expected fault errors and fatal exits are fixture assertions, not unobserved hardware failure.

fixed_acceptance.window_rgb_encoding: sRGB, compared with fixed transfer of the independent linear reference
fixed_acceptance.edge_discontinuity_exclusions: Fixed independent reference, unchanged pixel/depth acceptance tolerances

production_application_launches.limit: Four actual Editor/Runtime Release launches on both GPUs with required validation; completion remains qualification NOT_RUN because these launches are not the full qualification workload.

protected_targets.scope: runtime-only and server-only configure/build/ALL boundary checks and --version; no source shader compiler/authoring dependency in Runtime; Server remains Core-only.

relocated_check.limits: Development tools remain installed; child PATH/environment and observed modules are isolated. Module polling observes loaded modules, not transient unload history.

diagnostic.message: Shader bundle must be an accessible regular file
Shader bundle payload SHA-256 does not match its header

runtime_distribution.scope: Package contains precompiled bundle, Runtime, pinned Vulkan loader and Release CRT, licenses and provenance; no source shader compiler, Python, EngineTools or Editor. Both device launches use validation off and qualify relocation/closure only; native required-validation rendering is recorded separately.

retained_failures.finding: One of 53 initial CTests failed: malformed UTF-8 path conversion threw MSVC system_error past the narrower filesystem_error handler.
retained_failures.resolution: Parser handles system_error; original malformed UTF-8 regression passes in final Windows and WSL suites.

retained_failures.finding: Fixture did not reach its requested framebuffer size under current Windows DPI behavior.
retained_failures.resolution: Explicitly normalize the framebuffer request before exact extent checks.

retained_failures.finding: Added state diagnostics exposed content/framebuffer 240x192 for the requested initial extent.
retained_failures.resolution: Fixture accounts for DPI sizing and checks actual framebuffer state.

retained_failures.finding: Windows decorated-window minimum width clamped the requested 160 width to 176.
retained_failures.resolution: Fixture selects realizable 192x128,256x192,192x192 extents before image acceptance; reference geometry, pixel/depth tolerances and exclusions were not relaxed.

retained_failures.finding: Native fault evidence rejected stale compiled source identity after fixture changes.
retained_failures.resolution: Recompiled the fixture and reran all three faults on both devices/configurations.

retained_failures.finding: Initial package publication returned WinError 5 during atomic directory rename.
retained_failures.resolution: Preserved the failure; a new fresh runtime-package-02 destination published successfully. No overwrite or unsafe retry was added.

retained_failures.finding: Initial isolated-helper text decoding was not reliable Unicode diagnostic evidence.
retained_failures.resolution: Explicit UTF-8 stdout/stderr decoding added to the helper; focused 17 package tests and exact relocated missing/corrupt Unicode diagnostic checks rerun. Earlier records are retained, not used as final Unicode proof.

limitations: Hash integrity is not shader authenticity or a hostile-program sandbox.
The fixed cube and CLI are development diagnostics, not a game-authoring UI/API, scene/material system, live MMO or production-capacity evidence.
Native failure injection proves owned lifetime and diagnostic policy using healthy-driver cleanup, not recovery from physical GPU removal.
Local package module polling does not record transient unload history and is not an independent clean machine.
FeatureWorld connection remains assignment 10; the current executable fixtures provide explicit coverage until then.
